fontFamilies.sans: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'SF Pro Display', 'SF Pro Text', 'Helvetica Neue', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

colors.description: Brand blue — links and primary actions

depth.name: rest
depth.description: Flat surfaces — Apple design is flat, no shadows

theme.atmosphere: Minimalist, premium, product-centric. Huge white space, generous section gaps, enormous hero typography in semibold SF Pro, pill-shaped blue buttons, flat surfaces with zero shadows. Content is centered and breathing; the design does the talking, not decoration.

breakpoints.name: mobile
breakpoints.layout: Single column, stacked cards, hero scales down

responsive.touchTargets: Minimum 44px tap targets — Apple's standard is 44px.
responsive.collapseStrategy: Global nav collapses into hamburger below 768px; card grids collapse to single column.

do: Use SF Pro (system sans) for everything — never serif
Use the accent blue #0071e3 ONLY for links and primary buttons, never as surface color
Keep massive whitespace: sections are separated by at least 96px
Headlines are huge (Display 56px+) and semibold — they carry the design
Buttons are pill-shaped (border-radius 980px) with generous padding
Keep surfaces flat — no shadows, no borders on cards, just background color changes (#f5f5f7 on #ffffff)
dont: Don't use shadows or elevation — Apple is flat
Don't color the background with accent blue — white and #f5f5f7 only
Don't use uppercase headline styles — Apple headlines are title case
Don't squeeze content — spacing is part of the design language
Don't use pure #000 for text on light backgrounds — use #1d1d1f

promptGuide.quickReference: bg #ffffff · text #1d1d1f / #6e6e73 · accent #0071e3 · SF Pro sans · pill buttons · flat surfaces
starterPrompts: Build a blog: white background, huge semibold headline, article cards on #f5f5f7 with 18px radius, blue text links.
Build a product landing section: giant headline, secondary gray text, pill-shaped blue CTA button, centered.
